collisionDialog.keepBody: Both "{{name}}" entities will continue to exist with the same name. Retrieval treats them by id, but storyteller responses may conflate them in prose. Polymorphic naming is a documented v1 limitation — the schema doesn't enforce unique names. The flag clears; no other writes.
